requirements.text: Instants are formatted in an explicit IANA time zone (the user's preference), never the server's zone
Offsets and wall times are correct across DST transitions, and ambiguous or skipped local times are handled when parsing
Date-only values (due dates, birthdays) never shift by a day across time zones
Invalid dates and unknown time zones are rejected
Instants are stored in UTC and exchanged as ISO 8601 with an offset

implementations.notes: formatDate(value, locale, timeZone) via Intl; tests/source-examples.test.mjs compiles it but only exercises formatMoney

evidence.name: date ranges and business days are UTC-safe
